meta.source: User medal photos + Strava export + official/historical event calendars
meta.policy: Only publish records where medal/user evidence and Strava/event evidence align. Official race distances take precedence over GPS distance; virtual completion dates are preserved separately from the organizer event date.

adventures.name: Super Bowl 5K
adventures.matchSource: User finisher medal + RunDenver 2022 archive + virtual-completion Strava activity within the organizer's one-week reporting window
adventures.note: The medal belongs to the 2021-22 RunDenver series. Strava records a 5K-scale run in Steamboat Springs on February 12, consistent with a virtual completion after the in-person event; no official individual result has yet been recovered.

adventures.name: Valentine's Day 4 Mile
adventures.matchSource: User finisher medal + official event date/distance + virtual-completion Strava activity within the organizer's one-week reporting window
adventures.note: The in-person race was February 13 at Washington Park. Strava records the 4.05-mile virtual completion on February 20, the last day of RunDenver's permitted one-week virtual-results window.

adventures.name: Flying Pig 10K
adventures.resultSource: Flying Pig Marathon official Skyline Chili Challenge definition; individual 2025 result pending recovery
adventures.matchSource: User confirmation of Skyline Chili 4-Way Challenge participation + official challenge requirement
adventures.note: The official Skyline Chili 4-Way Challenge requires the Saturday 5K and 10K plus Sunday's full marathon. The Strava export contains the 5K and marathon but no separate 10K recording; no 10K time is inferred or invented.
